items.title: Nordic nRF54LC10A – A tiny Bluetooth LE and 802.15.4 SoC with sub-50 nA hibernation mode
items.summary: Nordic Semiconductor recently expanded its nRF54L Series with the nRF54LC10A, a new SoC with less memory and a smaller peripheral set compared to the higher-end nRF54L15, while supporting Bluetooth LE with Channel Sounding and IEEE 802.15.4 for Thread, Zigbee, and Matter. Built on a 22nm process, the SoC combines a 128 MHz Arm Cortex-M33 processor with a multiprotocol 2.4 GHz radio. It also features a sub-50 nA hibernation mode for devices shipped with (3V) batteries installed, reducing battery drain during storage and transportation. items.title: CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: The AIMORELOGY Ovis is an open-source AI vision camera module built around the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, with full-color 1080p night vision and 1.5 TOPS edge AI inference in a compact modular design. It is designed for drones, robotics, security systems, smart cameras, and custom embedded vision products. The camera features a compact stacked design, with a 20 × 20 mm Core board that includes the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, 2 Gbit NAND flash, USB, and UART debug pads. A Sensor board with the SC235HAI image sensor connects on top and also adds Ethernet and UART interfaces. An optional CVBS board goes between the Sensor board and the Ovis Core board. items.title: Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers
items.summary: Last year, we saw Morse Micro introduce the MM8108 Wi-Fi HaLow (802.11ah) SoC with up to 43.33 Mbps throughput, along with an MM8108-RD09 USB dongle reference design, for which we had virtually no details at the time. Morse Micro has now released USB-A and USB-C Wi-Fi HaLow adapters based on that reference design. The adapters let PCs and routers connect to 802.11ah networks through USB without a dedicated expansion card and feature an external SMA antenna delivering up to 26 dBm transmit power. Wi-Fi HaLow USB network adapter specifications: SoC – Morse Micro MM8108 32-bit RISC-V Host Applications Processor (HAP) Standard – IEEE802.11ah Wi-Fi HaLow Frequency band – 850-950 MHz (Worldwide sub-1 GHz license-exempt range) Operating Modes – Access Point (AP) and Station (STA). Channel Width – 1/2/4/8 MHz Modulation – BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, 256QAM. Data rate – Up to 43.3 Mbps using 256-QAM modulation at an 8 MHz bandwidth [...] The post Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Morse Micro推出Wi-Fi HaLow USB适配器，支持802.11ah网络接入
items.summary_zh: Morse Micro推出基于MM8108 SoC的USB-A和USB-C Wi-Fi HaLow适配器。该SoC集成32位RISC-V处理器，支持IEEE 802.11ah标准，工作于850–950 MHz频段，最高数据速率43.3 Mbps，配备外部SMA天线可实现最高26 dBm发射功率，让PC和路由器无需专用扩展卡即可接入Wi-Fi HaLow网络。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Wi-Fi HaLow通过USB适配器形态降低接入门槛，有助于推动802.11ah在物联网场景的普及。

items.title: JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity
items.summary: JetKVM Mini is a smaller, lower-cost version of the popular JetKVM KVM over IP solution. The new model features a small information display, offers Ethernet or WiFi connectivity, and supports 1080p video capture. The main under-the-hood change is that they ditched Linux on a Rockchip RV1106G3 SoC and now rely on an ESP32-P4X (ESP32-P4 version 3.x and greater) to handle video capture, H.264 encoding, USB, and other features. The largest cost saving is removing the RAM and eMMC flash required by Linux. JetKVM Mini specifications: SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-P4X CPU Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V HP (High-performance) CPU @ up to 400 MHz with AI instruction extension and single-precision FPU Single-RISC-V LP (Low-power) MCU core @ up to 40 MHz Memory 768 KB HP L2MEM (for dual-core CPU), 32 KB LP SRAM, 8 KB TCM (for LP MCU core) 32 MB PSRAM Storage – 128 KB HP ROM, 16 KB LP ROM [...] The post JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: JetKVM Mini发布：基于ESP32-P4X的低成本KVM方案
items.summary_zh: JetKVM Mini是JetKVM的低成本版本，采用Espressif ESP32-P4X取代此前基于Linux的Rockchip RV1106G3方案。ESP32-P4X集成双核32位RISC-V HP CPU（最高400 MHz）和单核LP MCU（最高40 MHz），无需RAM与eMMC即可处理1080p视频采集与H.264编码，并通过以太网或WiFi实现KVM over IP连接。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 移除Linux依赖后显著降低成本，展示了ESP32-P4X在视频KVM等嵌入式场景的替代能力。

items.why_it_matters_zh: AVX10_V2_AUX是ACE关键组件，进入LLVM 24意味着相关AI加速能力将获主流编译器生态支持。

items.title: Approaching A 10 Second Linux Kernel Build
items.summary: The coffee window is closing. Going back many years with the time it's taken to compile the Linux kernel has been a well known opportunity for a coffee break or even eating a meal during the lengthy Linux kernel build process. Even when the Linux kernel was much smaller than it is today, with the hardware at the time it would often be a very time consuming process... Thus incredible to think that we are now on the horizon of a ten second clean, default kernel build on Linux x86_64.
items.title_zh: Linux 内核构建时间逼近 10 秒大关
items.summary_zh: 长期以来 Linux 内核编译耗时漫长，曾是开发者喝咖啡甚至用餐的理由。如今在 x86_64 平台上，干净、默认配置的内核构建有望压缩到 10 秒以内。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编译速度大幅提升将显著改善开发者效率，也反映编译器与硬件的持续进步。

items.title: Patches Posted For Enabling NVMe On All Apple M3 Based SoCs With Linux
items.summary: While Linux 7.2 brought initial Apple M3 support and Linux 7.3 brought M3 Pro / Max / Ultra support, the mainline Linux kernel support for the M3 series hardware remains very basic and not yet ready for daily driving. But more work continues to be upstreamed and today the patches were posted for getting NVMe storage up and running across all Apple M3 hardware...
items.title_zh: 补丁已发布：为Linux启用Apple M3全系SoC的NVMe支持
items.summary_zh: Linux 7.2带来Apple M3初步支持，7.3增加M3 Pro/Max/Ultra支持，但主线内核对M3系列的硬件支持仍很基础。最新提交的补丁旨在让所有M3硬件的NVMe存储正常运行。
items.why_it_matters_zh: NVMe是日常使用的关键存储接口，补丁上游化意味着Apple Silicon在Linux下的兼容性将进一步提升。

items.title: Linux Kernel Developers Consider Adding AGENTS.md To Help Guide AI/LLM Agents
items.summary: While the Linux kernel continues to be bombarded with patches from AI/LLM agents, to date the kernel hasn't carried an AGENTS.md Markdown file with instructions catering to AI/LLM agents. But a patch set out today would finally introduce one...
items.title_zh: Linux内核开发者考虑引入AGENTS.md以引导AI/LLM代理
items.summary_zh: Linux内核虽长期遭受AI/LLM代理提交的补丁轰炸，但一直没有专门的AGENTS.md说明文件。今日发布的补丁集将首次引入该文件，为AI代理提供规范指引。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 通过统一AI代理行为规范，有望减少低质量自动补丁，降低维护者审核负担并改进协作流程。

items.title: AMD Posts GCC Compiler Patches For AVX10V1AUX ISA Support
items.summary: Following their recent AVX10_V2_AUX support for GCC as part of the bring-up for the AI Compute Extensions "ACE" in GCC 17, AMD compiler engineers this week posted the initial patches for enabling the AVX10V1AUX ISA support...
items.title_zh: AMD提交GCC补丁以支持AVX10V1AUX指令集
items.summary_zh: AMD工程师发布GCC编译器补丁，新增对AVX10V1AUX指令集的支持，这是继此前为GCC 17添加AVX10_V2_AUX支持后的后续工作，旨在推动其AI计算扩展（ACE）项目的编译器落地。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 完善AMD AVX10指令集在开源编译器中的生态，为AI计算扩展构建更完整的工具链支持。

items.title: Linux Kernel Introducing New Taint Due To Fuzzing Bots Yielding Impractical Bug Reports
items.summary: The Linux kernel is having to introduce a new taint flag "TAINT_FORCED_BIND" to deal with fuzzing bots like Syzbot abusing Linux's bind/unbind sysfs functionality and generating bug reports for impractical and not at all relevant hardware/driver combinations...
items.title_zh: Linux内核新增污点标志以应对模糊测试机器人滥用
items.summary_zh: Linux内核新增TAINT_FORCED_BIND污点标志，专门处理Syzbot等模糊测试机器人滥用bind/unbind sysfs功能并产生大量与实际硬件/驱动组合无关的不切实际bug报告的问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 帮助维护者快速识别并过滤模糊测试机器人产生的不切实际报告，减轻内核bug triage负担。

The Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 features Adreno 850 graphics and already one-day later their engineers are out with initial Linux kernel patches for bringing up the A850 with the MSM kernel driver...

items.title: CyboPal ONE – An AI-powered, 6-DOF robotic terminal with 27-inch 4K display that adjusts to your posture (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: CyboPal ONE is a 6-axis desktop robotic terminal designed to move a 27-inch 4K display using voice and gesture control, spatial sensing, and automatic display positioning based on the user’s position. It includes a camera, a binocular 3D sensor, and a motion sensor (IMU), and supports joint force sensing, obstacle avoidance, collision detection, and power-loss soft landing. The 6-DOF arm has a 747 mm reach and supports face tracking, manual adjustment, and saved positions. A built-in Pauli agent also provides voice control for screen positioning, application control, text input, and workflow tasks across Windows, macOS, and Linux. items.title: Brainchip AKD1500 M.2 and PCIe Edge AI cards, BrainBoard 1500 SPI module now available for $99 and up
items.summary: Back in November 2025, we wrote about the Brainchip AKD1500 PCIe/SPI Edge AI co-processor designed for low-power systems and delivering up to 800 GOPS at just 300 mW. In recent months, the company has launched several hardware platforms based on the ADK1500. At the end of July, Brainchip introduced the AKD1500 M.2 B+M Key development card for $129, shortly followed by the $99 BrainBoard 1500 module in August, and a few days ago, the company started selling the AKD1500 PCIe development card for $149.
